title: no round-trip test: sign() + parse() + verify() with byte ranges
description: smime_tests.rs tests sign output against openssl and decrypt output against openssl, but there is no test that: (1) calls sign(), (2) feeds the output to mime_tree::parse(), (3) extracts the signed part using body_range, and (4) calls verify() with those bytes. This is the crate's primary documented use case (CLAUDE.md: 'ParsedPart byte ranges are used in verify() to locate the exact signed bytes'). Without this test, the claim that sign+parse+verify is a working path is untested. The CRLF-appending issue in C3 would be caught by this test.
close_reason: Done: test_sign_verify_roundtrip_via_mime_tree added to smime_tests.rs; passes.
